subject: Request: non-adaptive commitment, KMS residency & evidence for procurement
messages:
From: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@medidoc.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@medidoc.com
Date: 2028-11-15T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Procurement ask: non-adaptive commitment and evidence pack

Hi Alex,

Thanks for the demo last week — procurement asked me to collect a short packet so we can clear legal and security. Our checklist is pretty standard for health data vendors but we want explicit confirmation on a few items related to LLM usage before we proceed to the PO: 

- A non-adaptive / no-model-improvement commitment for customer data (we call this "no-training"), and whether that applies to ephemeral chat sessions vs persisted transcripts.
- Prompt/response ownership: confirmation that our prompts/outputs are not used to improve models or derived into other customers' data sets.
- A list of subprocessors and whether any handle model training or fine-tuning; annotated with region/residency (onshore/eu/apac).
- KMS topology / whether customer keys can be used or if Redwood uses provider-managed keys (we need details for FedRAMP readiness).
- Evidence pointers (S3/SFTP exports, deletion proofs, audit logs) and any minimum SLA for exports.

Attached is our standard procurement questionnaire and a sample DPA redline for reference. Can you confirm which of the above Redwood can provide as documented evidence, and give an estimated timeline for procurement to close? We have an internal deadline of 2028-11-22 for vendor selection.

Regards,
Sarah Liu
Senior Procurement Manager
MediDoc Health

Attachments: medidoc_procurement_q1.xlsx (questionnaire), sample_dpa_redline.pdf
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@medidoc.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-11-15T13:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Procurement ask: non-adaptive commitment and evidence pack

Hi Sarah — thanks for the clear checklist and the timeline. Looping in Laura from Legal and our Ops lead (I copied Laura so she can triage the DPA redline and assemble the evidence pack). Quick answers up front:

- Non-adaptive (no-train) commitment: yes, we can offer a contractual no-model-improvement commitment for tenant-scoped data. There are operational modes (ephemeral session vs stored logs) that we need to map to your use case so the carveout applies correctly.
- Prompt/response ownership: we will commit that customer prompts and generated outputs are not used for model improvement unless a customer opts in; we will provide the operational proof artifacts.
- Subprocessors: full current list is available; none of our listed subprocessors perform cross-customer model training on customer raw prompts — we'll annotate residency per subprocessor.
- KMS: customers can bring their own keys (BYOK) in our Dedicated/Private deployments; for hosted we offer HSM-backed keys and can provide topology and attestations for key separation.
- Evidence and exports: we can produce SFTP export runs, deletion receipts, and audit log extracts. We will include tokenized examples for redaction-sensitive items.

Ask: Laura, can you draft a short evidence checklist and confirm whether we can provide the DPA redline acceptance by EOD tomorrow? If not, please propose a cadence and which artifacts require Ops/Infra signoff.

Sarah — if helpful, I can propose a mutual action plan (MAP) and a 30-min call to close the procurement items by 2028-11-22. What time window works for you?

Thanks,
Alex Martinez
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2028-11-15T16:10:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Procurement ask: non-adaptive commitment and evidence pack

Alex — drafting the checklist below. I also reviewed the sample DPA redline; high level comments included inline (see attachment stub). I'll need Ops to sign the KMS topology sheet and the infra security team to provide the audit-log extraction steps; Ops, please review and flag any timeline constraints.

Evidence checklist (to provide to MediDoc):
1) Signed DPA addendum with explicit "No-model-improvement" clause (scoped to customer tenant data and ephemeral session handling).
2) Operational runbook excerpt showing how ephemeral sessions are isolated and how KV cache is not persisted for tenant-improving flows.
3) Subprocessor register: names, roles, region (onshore/eu/apac), and explicit statement that none perform cross-customer model training on raw prompts.
4) KMS topology diagram + statement of support for BYOK and HSM-backed keys for hosted tiers; indicate which tiers support onshore key residency.
5) Export and deletion evidence options: sample SFTP export manifest, sample deletion confirmation (object-level deletion receipts), and audit log snippet showing export timestamp + actor.
6) SLA and timeline for evidence delivery (we should commit to a 5 business-day turnaround for standard evidence packs after countersigned DPA).

Attachments (stubs): medidoc_dpa_redline.pdf (redline comments inline), kms_topology_summary.xlsx (to be completed by Ops).

Ops action items:
- Provide KMS topology + statement of whether we can offer onshore key storage for MD region by 11/17 EOD.
- Prepare sample audit log extraction CSV and SFTP export manifest (redacted) by 11/17.

Once Ops confirms, Alex please send the evidence pack link and propose the MAP call.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Security
Redwood Inference

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@medidoc.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, procurement@medidoc.com
Date: 2028-11-16T16:43:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Procurement ask: non-adaptive commitment and evidence pack

Hi Sarah — attaching the evidence packet we've assembled and next steps below. Laura and Ops confirmed most items; Ops is finishing the KMS topology sheet and will upload the final topology by EOD tomorrow.

What I'm sending now (links/attachments included):
- Draft DPA addendum with no-model-improvement clause (attachment: medidoc_dpa_redline.pdf, inline comments).
- Preliminary subprocessor register (link: https://drive.redwood.example.com/MD-4821/evidence-pack).
- Example SFTP export manifest and deletion receipt (attachment: kms_topology_summary.xlsx contains sample export manifest tab).
- Proposed MAP: 30-min call on 2028-11-17 10:00-10:30 PT to walk through remaining KMS details and finalize signatures. I can send an invite if that slot works.

Commitments and timeline:
- Redwood confirms contractual no-model-improvement (no-training) for MediDoc tenant-scoped data once DPA addendum is signed.
- Evidence pack: final artifacts (including KMS topology and audit-log extract) to be delivered within 2 business days after countersignature; Ops currently estimates 1 business day to complete KMS doc.

Please reply with availability for the 11/17 MAP call or propose an alternative. If procurement wants a DocuSign flow, I can initiate the envelope once we agree the DPA redline.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.com

Attachments: medidoc_dpa_redline.pdf (redline + legal notes), kms_topology_summary.xlsx (sample export manifest tab)
